title: Chronicle of a Death Foretold
author: Gabriel García Márquez
summary: A narrator returns to his Colombian hometown to piece together why everyone knew Santiago Nasar would be murdered, yet no one stopped it. It reconstructs the day through shifting memories.
readIf: you want a short, precise novella about fate, honour and collective guilt.
skipIf: you prefer a straight mystery, since the killing is announced on page one.
